risks.title: Supply-chain compromise
risks.description: A malicious or tampered component enters the software supply chain and reaches production.
attack_vectors: Tampered build artifact between build and deploy
Unsigned or substituted artifact accepted by the deploy

risks.title: Unauthorised deployment
risks.description: A change reaches production without the required review, approval or provenance.
attack_vectors: Deploy of an artifact with no recorded build provenance

risks.title: Vulnerable software in production
risks.description: Software with known, exploitable vulnerabilities is released and left running.
attack_vectors: No re-evaluation of running artifacts as new CVEs land

risks.title: Insider threat
risks.description: A privileged individual abuses access to introduce or approve a malicious change.
attack_vectors: Author approves and deploys their own change

risks.title: Configuration drift
risks.description: The running environment diverges from its approved, recorded configuration.
attack_vectors: Out-of-band manual change to a running workload
Shadow deployment never recorded as provenance

risks.title: Audit & compliance failure
risks.description: Evidence of control operation is missing, incomplete or tamperable at audit time.
attack_vectors: No mapping from controls to framework clauses

risks.title: Credential & secret exposure
risks.description: Secrets are leaked through source, logs, images or misconfigured stores.
attack_vectors: Secret baked into an image or printed to logs
Over-broad access to a secret store

risks.title: Environment breach
risks.description: An attacker gains a foothold in a runtime environment and operates undetected.

risks.title: Unauthorised system access
risks.description: A person or service obtains access beyond what their role requires.
attack_vectors: No separation of duties on sensitive actions
